messages:
David: Quick sync — PR #16021 is ready for cross-team review. This touches the runtime batcher config and the platform routing policy. Planning to merge tomorrow 09:30am PT if no blockers. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/16021 :eyes:

Mia (runtime): Skimming now. main question: did you keep KV cache TTL change gated? If not we should canary it.

David: Yes, TTL is behind feature flag `kv_ttl_opt`. I'll paste config snippet:
```
batcher:
  max_batch_size: 64
  kv_cache_ttl_s: 300
feature_flags:
  kv_ttl_opt: off
```

Raj (platform): I'm on call tomorrow morning until 11. Can do canary traffic routing for 30m. Please add me as canary owner in the PR description.

Priya (security): Quick sec note — this PR introduces a new S3 signer role policy. I'll review the IAM diff but FYI we may need IAM review approval before merging.

David: Thanks — added Raj as canary owner and linked the IAM diff. @Priya plz ping if config needs stricter scoping.

infra-bot: Reminder: Merge window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT for runtime changes. Please run `make infra-checks` before merging.

Mia (runtime): Ran unit + e2e locally. Found a flaky test `test_batcher_evictions` — repro steps in PR comments. Will follow up with a small fix; shouldn't block merge if tests are green in CI after fix.

Raj (platform): OK. If @Priya clears IAM it's good from platform; I'll schedule a 10:00 canary and watch per-route latency.

Priya (security): Reviewing now. If I ask for scoping changes, can we postpone merge by 2 hours? I'm aiming to finish in the next 45m.

David: Sounds good. If any hold, we'll delay to next window. Thanks all :rocket:

Mia (runtime): one more: for the fallback policy we should toggle `fallback_model: "small-v1"` during canary. Added comment.

Raj (platform): noted.

Priya (security): LGTM with minor IAM scoping tweaks; pushed suggestions.

David: Addressed suggestions and force-pushed. CI green. Today 10:00 canary scheduled. Tagging final owners: @Mia, @Raj, @Priya :thumbsup:
